description: Read BetSlip Doctor’s league order right now: the same leagues in the same order as the app’s league strip (its Home and Odds chips: games in play first, then the soonest tip within 6 hours, then games in the next 24 hours); Tennis, Soccer and Golf are sport chips and carry their SPRT_ id. Each row has rank, weight and phase (this week’s popularity times season phase), inSeason and featured. `slate` carries the default league and the featured game (the in-play or soonest game with the most markets), refreshed every 5 minutes. Lists only leagues in season with a DraftKings price right now (the same leagues as the app’s chips, search and league lists); a league leaves when it has no priced game and comes back by itself when it does. Read-only; no account data.
name: get_league_order
title: Read the league order
